newsitem.title: USA: Open Plan sees Q3 EPS below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Open Plan sees Q3 EPS below expectations.

text.p: Open Plan Systems Inc said on Tuesday it expects third quarter earnings per share to be below $0.10 a share, which is below the company's and analysts' forecasts.
The company, which held an initial public offering in May, said it expects revenues of $4.5 million, which is 33 percent more than a year ago, but less than expected.
Two brokers who follow the company have a consensus earnings estimate of $0.10 a share, according to First Call estimates.
Open Plan said it is optimistic about its fourth quarter prospects as the company combines operations with TFM Remanufactured Office Furniture, which the company agreed to acquire.
TFM is expected to generate revenues for the calendar year of $7 million for 1996, Open Plan said.
